analyzed_vuln.description: audio_sample_entry_box_read() manually deletes ptr->esd via gf_isom_box_del_parent(&ptr->child_boxes, (GF_Box*)ptr->esd) when scanning malformed QTFF-style payload, but does not clear/remove all ownership references consistently before later teardown. The same ESDS box pointer remains reachable in the parent/child destruction path, so during movie close gf_isom_box_del() walks child_boxes and calls del_fn on an already-freed ESDS, causing heap-use-after-free in gf_isom_box_del (read of a->child_boxes from freed object).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A crafted mp4a sample entry containing a wave/esds layout that triggers the fallback scan path in audio_sample_entry_box_read (after gf_isom_box_array_read error) causes ptr->esd to be deleted and reparsed/reinserted inconsistently. On cleanup (gf_isom_close -> gf_isom_delete_movie -> recursive gf_isom_box_del/gf_isom_box_array_del), the stale ESDS reference is deleted again, producing UAF/double-delete behavior. The provided PoC with tiny mp4a/wave/esds boxes triggers this path.
